Welcome to Memora

A self-hosted memory vault: your notes as plain Markdown, wired into a living brain that your AI agents read and write over MCP. What they learn stays.

  • Vault Your notes stay plain Markdown files, in a folder you choose
  • Brain, Graph, Canvas See how every note connects: in 3D, as a graph, or on a board
  • Set up once, use everywhere Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT and your own agents share one memory, each with its own key, instead of being taught the same things again
  • From anywhere on this machine, your local network, or the internet through a tunnel or reverse proxy

Set it up in two steps

  1. 1
    Get a one-time code on the server
    Run this command
    memora-cli setup --minutes 15

    It prints a one-time code and the link to this page.

  2. 2
    Enter the code here

    This page moves on by itself once the code is ready to enter.
